versions.changelog:
- Initial release of auto-report: automated generation and scheduled delivery of daily, weekly, and monthly reports.
- Supports cron-based scheduling for reports with customizable templates and structured summaries.
- Delivers reports to any OpenClaw channel, including Feishu (Lark), with both card and plain text output.
- Provides guidance for cron setup, quality standards, and advanced report chaining.
- Compatible with all OpenClaw channels and requires no external dependencies.
